## Finding the Pattern

Looking at the differences between consecutive terms:

| Pair | Difference |
|------|-----------|
| −2 − (−9) | **7** |
| 5 − (−2) | **7** |
| 12 − 5 | **7** |
| 19 − 12 | **7** |
| 26 − 19 | **7** |

This is an **arithmetic sequence** with a common difference of **7**.

So the next term is:

$$26 + 7 = 33$$

<answer>33</answer>
